# Sources

Unmodified icons from open source icon sets, chosen
for conventions that differ from Tabler (stroke widths of 1.5, `<polyline>`,
`<circle>` and `<rect>` elements, stroke attributes on individual elements,
unusual path data):

| prefix | project | license |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feather-` | [Feather](https://github.com/feathericons/feather) | MIT |
| `lucide-` | [Lucide](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide) | ISC |
| `heroicons-` | [Heroicons](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons) | MIT |
| `iconoir-` | [Iconoir](https://github.com/iconoir-icons/iconoir) | MIT |
